Purpose and intended use
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

*Generated from linked report records.*

The tool is evaluated for the following intended use cases. The use case title
is the concise statement of the project context in which the tool is used; the
detailed evaluation is shown in the sections below.


* :need:`Enforce document types and attributes <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__metamodel>`: Enforce document types and mandatory attributes such as id, status, security, safety, and realizes. See, for example, :need:`gd_req__doc_attr_status`, :need:`gd_req__req_attr_uid`, :need:`gd_req__req_attr_safety`, :need:`gd_req__arch_attr_safety`, and :need:`gd_req__req_check_mandatory`.

* :need:`Enforce safety-critical links <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__safety_links>`: Enforce that links between safety-relevant needs preserve the required safety relationships. See :need:`gd_req__req_linkage_safety`.

* :need:`Calculate requirement coverage <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__coverage>`: Count, per requirement type, the requirements carrying a ``testlink`` and compute link-coverage percentages. See :need:`gd_req__verification_reporting`.

* :need:`Generate architecture diagrams <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__architecture>`: Generate architecture diagrams. See :need:`gd_req__arch_viewpoints`.

* :need:`Resolve testcase verification links <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__test_linkage>`: For each ``testcase`` need, resolve its ``partially_verifies``/``fully_verifies`` references against the needs set. See :need:`gd_req__req_attr_testlink` and :need:`gd_req__verification_reporting`.

* :need:`Validate testcase references <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__test_refs>`: Check that test references are present and point to the intended requirements. See :need:`gd_req__req_attr_testlink`.

* :need:`List assumptions of use <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__assumptions>`: Use ``needtable`` to communicate safety-critical assumptions of use in safety manuals. See :need:`gd_guidl__saf_man` and :need:`wp__platform_safety_manual`.

* :need:`Generate traceability backlinks <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__backlinks>`: Generate correct backlinks for links between Needs items to provide bi-directional traceability. See :need:`doc_concept__general_traceability`.

* :need:`Generate HTML documentation <tool_usecase__docs_as_code__generation>`: Generate complete and correct HTML apart from the aspects covered by the other use cases. See :need:`gd_req__doc_attributes_manual` and :need:`gd_req__doc_attr_status`.

tool_req__arch_consistency_interf.content:
Docs-as-Code shall check that any logical architectural interface linked to a feature
(via ``logic_arc_int included_by feat``) is matched by an ``implements`` link from a
component to that interface. Additionally it shall be checked that each feature
architecture is linked against at least one logical architectural interface.

Note: This requirement shall not break the build in score main, but emit a information instead, as the architecture is not yet complete and only complete visible in the reference integration repository.
tool_req__arch_consistency_interf.title: Check consistency of interfaces in modules

Enforce that Need IDs follow the following naming scheme:

* A prefix indicating the need type (e.g. `feature__`)
* A middle part matching the hierarchical structure of the need:
   * For requirements: a portion of the feature tree or a component acronym
   * For architecture elements: the structural element (e.g. a part of the feature tree, component acronym)
   * For safety analysis (FMEA, DFA): name of analyzed structural element (e.g. Persistency, FEO, etc.)
* Additional descriptive text to ensure human readability

tool_req__docs_common_attr_id_scheme.title: Enforces need ID scheme

tool_req__docs_common_attr_safety.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that the ``safety`` attribute has one of the following values:

* QM
* ASIL_B


This rule applies to:

* all requirement types defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_req_types`, except process and tool requirements.
* all architecture elements defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_arch_types`.
tool_req__docs_common_attr_safety.title: Safety: enforce classification

tool_req__docs_common_attr_safety_link_c.content: QM requirements (safety == QM) shall not be linked to safety requirements (safety != QM) via the ``derived_from`` attribute.
tool_req__docs_common_attr_safety_link_c.title: Safety: enforce safe linking

tool_req__docs_common_attr_security.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that the ``security`` attribute has one of the following values:

* YES
* NO

This rule applies to:

* all requirement types defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_req_types`, except process and tool requirements.
* all architecture elements defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_arch_types`.
tool_req__docs_common_attr_security.title: Security: enforce classification

tool_req__docs_common_attr_status.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that the ``status`` attribute has one of the following values:

* valid
* invalid

This rule applies to:

* all requirement types defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_req_types`, except process and tool requirements.
* all architecture elements defined in :need:`tool_req__docs_arch_types`.

tool_req__docs_common_attr_status.title: Status: enforce attribute

tool_req__docs_common_attr_suspicious.content:

tool_req__docs_common_attr_title.content:
Enforce that all needs have titles and titles do not contain the following words:

* shall
* must
* will
tool_req__docs_common_attr_title.title: Enforces title wording rules

tool_req__docs_common_attr_version.content:
Docs-As-Code shall enable and enforce a versioning attribute for all needs.

.. note::

tool_req__docs_dd_feature_flag.content:
Docs-as-Code shall allow for a to-be-defined list of checks to be non-fatal for non
release builds. These are typically better suited for metrics than for checks.

e.g. gd_req__req_linkage_architecture

tool_req__docs_dd_link_source_code_link.content:

A link to the corresponding source code location in GitHub shall be generated in the
generated documentation within the linked requirement.
tool_req__docs_dd_link_source_code_link.title: Supports linking to source code

tool_req__docs_doc_generic_mandatory.content:

* security
* safety
* realizes

tool_req__docs_doc_types.content:
Docs-as-Code shall support the following document types:

* Generic Document (document)
* Tool Verification Report (doc_tool)

A change request is also a generic document but not a Sphinx-Needs type, so out of scope here.
tool_req__docs_doc_types.title: Document Types

tool_req__docs_req_arch_link_safety_to_a.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that valid safety architectural elements (Safety != QM) can
only be linked against valid safety architectural elements.
tool_req__docs_req_arch_link_safety_to_a.title: Restrict links for safety requirements

tool_req__docs_req_attr_reqtype.content:

except process and tool requirements has a ``reqtype`` attribute with one of the
following values:

* Functional
* Interface
* Process
* Non-Functional
tool_req__docs_req_attr_reqtype.title: Enforces requirement type classification

tool_req__docs_req_attr_testcov.content:
Docs-As-Code shall allow for every need of type :need:`tool_req__docs_req_types` to
have a ``testcovered`` attribute, which must be one of:

* Yes
* No

.. note::

tool_req__docs_req_attr_validity_consist.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that ``valid_from`` is before ``valid_until`` attribute in stakeholder and feature requirements.
We consider "from" is inclusive but "until" is exclusive, so from v0.5 until v1.0 means valid for v0.5 but not for v1.0.
If either attribute is missing, no check is performed.
tool_req__docs_req_attr_validity_consist.title: Enforce validity start is before end

tool_req__docs_req_attr_validity_correct.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that the ``valid_from`` and ``valid_until`` attributes of stakeholder and feature requirements are correct.

The format of a milestone is something like "v0.5" or "v1.0.1".
No suffixes like "-SNAPSHOT" or "-beta" are allowed.
tool_req__docs_req_attr_validity_correct.title: Enforce validity attribute correctness

tool_req__docs_req_link_covers_aou.content:
Feature requirements (feat_req) and component requirements (comp_req)
link to Assumptions of Use (aou_req) via the ``covers`` attribute.
tool_req__docs_req_link_covers_aou.title: Requirement linkage to AoU via covers

* FMEA-only attribute: ``fault_id``

tool_req__docs_saf_attrs_mitigated_by.content:
Docs-As-Code shall enforce valid needs (`status` == `valid`) of type
:need:`tool_req__docs_saf_types` to have at least one `mitigated_by` link to a
requirement on the corresponding level.

At least one of the linked requirements must have
the same ASIL level or a higher one.

It can be ``comp_req`` or ``aou_req``.
tool_req__docs_saf_attrs_mitigated_by.title: Safety Analysis Mitigation Attribute

tool_req__docs_saf_attrs_mitigation_issu.content:

`mitigation_issue` attribute which links to a GitHub issue.

* no

* ``status``: ``valid`` or ``invalid``

Docs-as-Code shall ensure that test cases link to requirements on the correct level:

- If Partially/FullyVerifies are set in Feature Integration Test these shall link to Feature Requirements
- If Partially/FullyVerifies are set in Component Integration Test these shall link to Component Requirements
- If Partially/FullyVerifies are set in Unit Test these shall link to Component Requirements

tool_req__docs_test_metadata_mandatory_2.content:

tool_req__docs_tvr_confidence_level.content:
Docs-as-Code shall derive the Tool Confidence Level of a Tool Verification
Report from its owned potential tool malfunctions:

* ``LOW`` if an owned safety-relevant malfunction has insufficient detection
* ``HIGH`` otherwise
tool_req__docs_tvr_confidence_level.title: Enforce confidence level classification

tool_req__docs_tvr_safety.content:
Docs-as-Code shall derive the Tool Verification Report safety classification
from its owned potential tool malfunctions:

* ``YES`` if at least one owned malfunction is safety affected
* ``NO`` otherwise
tool_req__docs_tvr_safety.title: Enforce safety classification

tool_req__docs_tvr_security.content:

`security_affected` attribute with one of the following values:

* YES
* NO
tool_req__docs_tvr_security.title: Enforce security classification

tool_req__docs_tvr_status.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that every Tool Verification Report (`doc_tool`) includes a
`status` attribute with one of the following values:

* draft
* evaluated
* qualified
* released
* rejected
tool_req__docs_tvr_status.title: Enforce status classification

tool_req__docs_tvr_version.content:
Docs-as-Code shall enforce that every Tool Verification Report (`doc_tool`) includes a
`tool_version` attribute.
tool_req__docs_tvr_version.title: Enforce version attribute

tool_req__docs_verification_report_need.content:
Docs-as-Code shall support a machine-readable module verification report need type.

The need type shall:

* use ``mod_ver_report`` as directive type
* classify the report by ``safety``, ``security``, ``status`` and ``verification_method``
* link the report to the verified module via ``belongs_to``
* allow links to contained verification evidence via ``contains``
* allow links to covered artifacts via ``covers``
* allow links to backing documents or work products via ``evidence`` and ``realizes``
tool_req__docs_verification_report_need.parent_covered: NO: process wording is broader than the currently modeled report artifact.
tool_req__docs_verification_report_need.title: Support machine-readable module verification reports

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
